items.name: Tom Kha - Veg/Chicken/Prawns
items.description: A creamy and fragrant coconut milk broth infused with lemongrass, kaffir lime, galangal, and a hint of chili. Choose veg, chicken, or prawns for a delicious Thai-inspired treat!

items.name: Manchow Soup - Veg/Chicken
items.description: A zesty Indo-Chinese soup packed with bold flavours, crisp vegetables, and your choice of veg or chicken. Topped with crunchy fried noodles for the perfect finishing touch!

items.name: Hot & Sour Soup - Veg/Chicken
items.description: A perfect balance of tangy, spicy, and savoury flavours, this classic soup is a comforting delight with every spoonful

items.name: Tomato & Basil Soup
items.description: A velvety tomato soup delicately flavoured with aromatic Italian basil, offering a classic and comforting taste of Italy.

items.name: Broccoli Almond Soup
items.description: A rich and creamy blend of tender broccoli and toasted almonds, offering a hearty and wholesome flavour in every sip.

items.name: Cream Of Mushroom Soup
items.description: A velvety blend of fresh mushrooms simmered in a creamy broth, infused with delicate herbs and spices for a comforting and flavourful experience.

items.name: Cream Of Chicken Soup
items.description: Cream of chicken soup is a versatile, creamy soup made primarily with chicken broth, cream, and seasonings.

items.name: Greek Salad
items.description: A refreshing medley of cucumber, peppers, onion, tomato, and lettuce, topped with kalamata olives, crumbled feta cheese, and a zesty blend of olive oil, herbs, and lime. A true Mediterranean delight!

items.name: Caesar Salad (Veg/Chicken/Prawns)
items.description: A house favourite featuring crisp lettuce and golden croutons tossed in our signature caesar dressing. Enjoy it as is or add prawns or chicken for a hearty twist!

items.name: Buddha Bowl (Veg / Chicken)
items.description: A wholesome medley of flavors and nutrition, our Buddha Bowl features tender grilled chicken, juicy chicken sausages, fresh spinach, crunchy cabbage, protein-packed edamame, grilled mushrooms and fluffy quinoa. Served with a zesty dip, it's the perfect balance of health and indulgence in every bite.

items.name: Som Tam Salad
items.description: A zesty and refreshing Thai-inspired salad made with shredded raw papaya, crunchy sprouts, crisp French beans, cherry tomatoes, and red chili, all tossed in a flavorful peanut dressing.

items.name: Feta Watermelon Salad
items.description: A refreshing salad of juicy watermelon, creamy feta, and fresh herbs that perfectly balances sweet and savory flavors

items.name: Stuffed Mushroom

items.name: Paneer Tikka
